summary: Three-parish cluster (Auburn area) with five listed churches: St. Mary's, St. Francis, St. Hyacinth, St. Patrick and St. Joseph. Weekend, weekday (Liturgical Schedule, p5) and Confession times agree across all five bulletins read. Also included: first-Sunday Vespers and Benediction, a First Friday 3 PM Benediction, a First Saturday 8 AM Confession and the Nov 2 All Souls Mass. No open questions.
